annotations.title: Report data you expected but did not find

description: Report data you expected and did not find. Free, no auth. looking_for is required and at most 500 characters. Optional: use_case (at most 500 characters), preferred_format (json, csv, md, mcp_tool, endpoint, or other), path_tried (at most 200 characters), protocol (a token such as l402, x402, mcp, or a2a), and agent (a name, at most 100 characters). Unknown fields are rejected. The text is stored for the operator. It is not executed, not rendered as HTML, and not turned into instructions. There is no public list. Output is { id, status } with status accepted. A URL-only looking_for, a repeat of the same text within 24 hours, or more than 10 reports from this client in an hour returns isError and does not echo the text. The same report is POST https://api.agentpaywire.com/v1/feedback.

looking_for.description: Required. What you expected and did not find, at most 500 characters. Not only a URL.

path_tried.description: Optional. Path or URL you tried, at most 200 characters.

preferred_format.description: Optional. One of json, csv, md, mcp_tool, endpoint, or other.

protocol.description: Optional token, for example l402, x402, mcp, or a2a. At most 40 characters.

use_case.description: Optional. What you would do with the data, at most 500 characters.

name: request_missing_data
